# Completion Report — Work Order 6: MCP Pull Tools (`pr-08-v2-delivery-wo6`)

## Summary of Changes

The 5 MCP pull tools specified in §8.2 have been implemented in [`internal/mcpserver/`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/), replacing the single `memory.ask` stub while keeping `HandleMemoryAsk` deprecated for backward compatibility:

1. **`memory.brief`** ([`HandleMemoryBrief`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L60-L109)):
   - Accepts [`MemoryBriefRequest`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L15-L18) with `scope`.
   - Resolves aliases via `index.ResolveAlias` if not found directly.
   - Filters active (non-retired) entries.
   - Formats scope name, entry count, and entries as `[<type>] <id>: <text>` (truncated to 200 runes if needed).
   - Records each pull via `ledger.RecordPull(entryID)`.

2. **`memory.why`** ([`HandleMemoryWhy`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L111-L191)):
   - Accepts [`MemoryWhyRequest`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L25-L28) with `entryId`.
   - Fetches entry via `index.GetEntry` and entry history via `index.GetHistory`.
   - Formats type, text, anchors, evidence list, verification status, timestamps, and history (superseded by, retired reason).
   - Records the pull via `ledger.RecordPull(entryID)`.

3. **`memory.history`** ([`HandleMemoryHistory`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L193-L272)):
   - Accepts [`MemoryHistoryRequest`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L35-L38) with `scope`.
   - Resolves aliases and queries retired and superseded entries across `entries` and `entry_history`.
   - Formats entry ID, type, text, retired reason or superseded-by.
   - Records each pull via `ledger.RecordPull(entryID)`.

4. **`memory.search`** ([`HandleMemorySearch`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L274-L313)):
   - Accepts [`MemorySearchRequest`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L45-L48) with `query`.
   - Runs full-text search via `index.SearchEntries` (FTS5 BM25) and limits to top 10 results.
   - Formats ranked list with entry ID, type, scope, and text snippet (first 100 runes).
   - Records each pull via `ledger.RecordPull(entryID)`.

5. **`memory.note`** ([`HandleMemoryNote`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L315-L373)):
   - Accepts [`MemoryNoteRequest`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L55-L60) with `scope`, `text`, and optional `type` (defaults to `"decision"`).
   - Validates that `scope` and `text` are non-empty and `type` is a valid `dossiers.EntryType`.
   - Generates entry ID with type prefix and writes an `ops.OpAdd` batch to the ops directory via `ops.Writer`.
   - Returns `{ "result": "Note recorded: <entryID>" }`.

6. **Server Integration & Dynamic Dispatch** ([`server.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/server.go)):
   - Added `WithLedger` and `WithOpsWriter` options to [`NewServer`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L38-L47).
   - Added [`ListTools`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L69-L77) and [`CallTool`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L80-L140) for MCP server framework registration and dispatch.
   - Marked `HandleMemoryAsk` as deprecated.

7. **Comprehensive Tests** ([`tools_test.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.G1kENQdrEH/repo/internal/mcpserver/tools_test.go)):
   - Verified `memory.brief` formatting, filtering, 200-char truncation, and pull recording.
   - Verified `memory.brief` alias resolution.
   - Verified `memory.why` retrieval of anchors, evidence, history, and verification metadata.
   - Verified `memory.history` retired and superseded entries filtering.
   - Verified `memory.search` BM25 ranking, snippet truncation, top 10 limit, and no-results handling.
   - Verified `memory.note` op creation in op log, default type fallback, and validation.
   - Verified `ListTools` and `CallTool` dispatch.
